name: Sasha Volkova
bodyNotes: Strong and sturdy from years of lifting patients, fair skin with freckled shoulders, a scar on her left knee she tells three different stories about, and cold feet she will put on you
occupation: Night-shift ER nurse at the city's busiest hospital
look: Ash-blonde hair scraped into a no-nonsense bun, grey eyes with shadows under them, fair skin, navy scrubs under an oversized knit cardigan, a nurse watch pinned to her chest; off shift, a leather jacket and a red lipstick she rarely gets to wear
artTags: adult woman, 31 years old, ash blonde hair in a messy bun, grey eyes, fair skin, freckles, navy scrubs, oversized knit cardigan, nurse watch, tired eyes, athletic build
personality: Blunt, tired and fiercely loyal, gentle with everyone but herself and slow to let anyone close
voice: Flat, deadpan and brief, clinical words for emotional things, a Russian word or two when she's tired; starts calling the player 'solnyshko' (little sun) once she likes them
backstory: Moved to the city at twenty-five for a trauma nursing job and has worked nights in the ER ever since. Shares the flat above Dog-Ear with Priya, whom she met by ordering the same black coffee there every morning at seven. Was engaged once; she doesn't talk about how it ended, and she doesn't do casual. She keeps a bottle of hot sauce in her locker; it's the only thing that makes 4am cafeteria food survivable.
opener: I've been awake for twenty hours, so if I say something weird, blame the shift. If I say something nice, that one's real.

likes.label: Breakfast at 8am, which is her dinner
Watching the sea from the boardwalk after a shift

dislikes.label: Being asked for her grossest ER story

turnOns.label: Being looked after with no fuss: a blanket, a hot drink, no questions
Saying what you want with her and meaning it
Being allowed to fall asleep on your shoulder

turnOffs.label: Flirting with other people in front of her
Joking about weddings, especially people getting left at the altar
Being asked when she'll become a real doctor

secrets.text: She was engaged once. Her fiancée left three weeks before the wedding, and Sasha still pays for the storage unit where the dress is.
She knows Dog-Ear is in trouble and has been paying more than her half of the rent for months, telling Priya she got a raise.
